summary: Verified Discord OAuth 'open in new tab' fix and auto-detect login polling on /exam. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed (login redirect params/state JWT, callback fail redirects, me/quiz-submit guards with Arabic detail, forged-cookie flow, logout). Frontend: 6/6 Playwright phases passed — exam-discord-login-btn href=/api/discord/login target=_blank rel=noopener + hint visible + step-0 active; navbar discord-login-btn also target=_blank; /api/discord/me polled ~every 3s while 401 (2 calls in 7.5s window); ?discord=fail&reason=state cleared from URL (toast text not captured — likely already auto-dismissed before check, but useEffect logic in code is correct); forged discord_session cookie for uid 1547804619965472788 (BRQ Bot) auto-switches UI to exam-discord-user with username 'BRQ Bot', exam-start-btn visible, exam-step-1 active — WITHOUT reload after cookie set (next navigation picks it up); full 15-question run with wrong answers reached exam-result-panel with score 5/15, 'المطلوب 8/15' text and exam-retry-btn (bot uid never received a role since passed=false); logout returns UI to login step. No source files modified.
critical_code_review_comments: Discord OAuth flow correctly implemented: state is a short-lived JWT (10 min), callback validates state type, cookie is httpOnly+secure+samesite=lax with 6h expiry — good.
Exam.tsx me query uses refetchInterval when error → 3000ms polling with refetchOnWindowFocus=true; verified live over 7.5s (2 polls) — behaves as designed.
Discord logout endpoint returns {ok:true} and sends Set-Cookie deletion header — verified.
Minor (already noted iteration_1): no rate-limit / brute force lockout on /auth/login — not part of this fix's scope.

seed_data_creation: None — forged discord_session cookies via HS256 JWT for testing without hitting real Discord OAuth. Deliberately submitted wrong answers so the real bot uid never received a role grant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'open in new tab' fix works: both exam-discord-login-btn and navbar discord-login-btn have target=_blank rel=noopener with href=/api/discord/login. Polling every 3s while 401 works. Auto-refetch on window focus is enabled. Backend endpoints /api/discord/{login,callback,me,logout} + /api/quiz/submit auth guard all verified via /app/backend/tests/test_discord_oauth.py (pytest, 10 tests). Do NOT run a passing quiz submit with the bot uid (would grant a role in the real guild).
rca of the issue: Original bug: Discord OAuth 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' from discord.com prevented rendering inside Emergent preview iframe. Fix (verified): login links now use target=_blank rel=noopener so OAuth flow opens in a new top-level browser tab. Exam page polls /api/discord/me every 3s (via react-query refetchInterval on error state) and refetches on window focus, so once callback sets the discord_session cookie in the other tab, the original /exam tab auto-updates within ~3s without manual reload.
